en_how: Every shape is first laid down as a complete grey pencil underdrawing, each line traced twice slightly offset; the midground fields and cottage are transparent watercolour, polygons repeatedly subdivided into ragged edges and stacked dozens of times at low opacity, multiplied over the pencil; the foreground child, goose, tree and grassy bank are thick gouache, short strokes with a light edge placed at points scattered inside each shape and laid one by one; the distant mountains and tower stay pencil only, so the picture empties out with distance.
